builtInImagegen.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original character selection card artwork for a Chinese Journey to the West survivors-like mobile game.
Primary request: one polished landscape artwork containing exactly four individual full-body chibi game characters in four equally sized vertical panels, from left to right Sun Wukong, Tang Sanzang, Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing. Make each panel self-contained so it can be used as a portrait card. Each character has a distinctive silhouette and is entirely visible, including feet and weapon, with generous empty margins.
Subject details: Sun Wukong is a mischievous monkey hero in cinnabar red and warm gold armor, holding a gold-ended red staff. Tang Sanzang is a serene young Buddhist monk in ivory and sky-blue robes, with an ornate nine-ring pilgrim staff and a small blue holy glow. Zhu Bajie is a friendly stout pig-faced warrior with clearly visible pig ears and snout, in clay red/brown cloth, holding a nine-toothed rake. Sha Wujing is a composed sturdy pilgrim with a dark beard, teal and muted violet robes, bead necklace, and a crescent-headed demon-subduing staff.
Style/medium: hand-painted flat-color mobile game illustration, bold dark-brown ink outlines, readable simple shapes, warm parchment scroll aesthetic, tasteful broad cel shading, expressive original character faces. Match a lightweight Canvas 2D game's warm gold, vermilion, earthy ink palette. Do not imitate any modern film, TV, game or artist interpretation.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal 4-panel lineup, all four characters approximately the same visual height, feet on the same baseline, single three-quarter frontal pose each. Background is calm warm parchment with subtle Chinese cloud motifs, different gentle color washes for each panel, no scene clutter.
Constraints: exactly four characters, no additional figures, no logos, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no UI controls, no cropped weapons, no photorealism, no pixel art. Original reusable commercial game concept/card art.

visualInspection.notes: 角色选择与宣传卡面；不是透明战斗精灵，不是帧动画。

runtimeNotes: 原生Canvas renderer的程序化原创绘制是运行必需资源，无图片加载门槛。
SVG素材目前是设计/预览资源；不能假设wx Canvas会直接加载SVG，需经过平台验证或离线导出PNG后接入。
imagegen卡面原图约3.07MB，压缩/分包前应测量主包。
sourceRects将合图均分为四个无重叠区域，最后列宽478 px；运行时可用drawImage裁切，不必写出四张图片。
浏览器native入口加载5张透明妖怪/Boss SVG，并串行加载8套普通敌人32姿态PNG；微信Canvas保留renderer向量回退。
首关普通虎妖另串行加载32姿态PNG与实测矩形JSON；只绑定stage1+normal+tiger。130源像素统一缩放、固定脚底；精英/Boss仍用独立向量回退。
